name: Visual Studio Code
description: Éditeur de code de Microsoft. Debian et Ubuntu : installé depuis le dépôt de Microsoft, ses mises à jour arrivent avec celles du système. Arch : la version Microsoft n’est pas dans pacman mais dans l’AUR (visual-studio-code-bin) : elle est construite par un utilisateur sans droits, après vérification de ce que le paquet de l’AUR contient, puis installée avec pacman. Pas de mise à jour automatique (réinstaller pour passer à la dernière version). Incompatible avec Code - OSS.

command.install:
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
# Microsoft's own repository: apt checks its signature and brings new versions with the system updates.
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq ca-certificates curl gpg
curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor --yes -o /usr/share/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
chmod 644 /usr/share/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list
cat > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.sources <<'EOF'
Types: deb
URIs: https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code
Suites: stable
Components: main
Architectures: amd64,arm64,armhf
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
EOF
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y code
command.uninstall:
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get remove -y code
# The repository goes with the application.
rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.sources /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list
apt-get update -qq || true

command.install:
set -eu
# Microsoft's build comes from the AUR (visual-studio-code-bin), which is not in pacman. It is built by an unprivileged
# user (makepkg refuses to run as root), then installed with pacman. AUR packages are community packages that nobody at
# Arch reviews, so the parts that matter are checked below against what was read and tested.
if [ "$(pacman -Q code 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)" = code ]; then
  echo "Code - OSS (the package 'code') is installed and conflicts with Microsoft's build: remove it first (pacman -R code)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
pacman -S --needed --noconfirm base-devel git || { echo "pacman could not install base-devel and git: update the system first (pacman -Syu), then install again" >&2; exit 1; }
tmp=$(mktemp -d /var/tmp/vscode-aur-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
chown nobody:nobody "$tmp"
as_nobody() { runuser -u nobody -- env HOME="$tmp" "$@"; }
cd "$tmp"
as_nobody git clone --depth 1 https://aur.archlinux.org/visual-studio-code-bin.git
cd visual-studio-code-bin
for f in $(ls -A | grep -v '^\.git$'); do
  case "$f" in
    PKGBUILD|.SRCINFO|.gitignore|.nvchecker.toml|visual-studio-code-bin.install|visual-studio-code-bin.sh) ;;
    *) echo "unexpected file in the AUR package: $f" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
done
[ "$(sha256sum visual-studio-code-bin.install | cut -d' ' -f1)" = c910a24270895767939b23194673d76641432aa107e6e81ca8ad6f7a8fc6e9b7 ] || { echo "the install script of the AUR package changed: it runs as root, so it has to be reviewed first" >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$(sha256sum visual-studio-code-bin.sh | cut -d' ' -f1)" = bd0d9edf69283ebdf4e73e0a7b168d2fcf50acbd01f63674cad93ed4fe42fdad ] || { echo "the launcher of the AUR package changed: it has to be reviewed first" >&2; exit 1; }
hosts=$(grep -E '^source' PKGBUILD | grep -oE 'https?://[^/) ]+' | sort -u)
[ "$hosts" = "https://update.code.visualstudio.com" ] || { echo "the AUR package downloads from somewhere other than Microsoft: $hosts" >&2; exit 1; }
if grep -nE 'curl|wget|eval|base64|/dev/tcp|git clone' PKGBUILD >&2; then echo "the PKGBUILD changed in a way that has to be reviewed first" >&2; exit 1; fi
# --nodeps: makepkg would refuse to build until the runtime libraries are installed; pacman -U below installs them.
as_nobody makepkg --noconfirm --nodeps
set -- ./visual-studio-code-bin-*.pkg.tar.*
[ "$#" = 1 ] && [ -e "$1" ] || { echo "makepkg did not produce exactly one package" >&2; exit 1; }
pacman -U --noconfirm "$1" || { echo "pacman could not install the package: update the system first (pacman -Syu), then install again" >&2; exit 1; }

name: Code - OSS
description: La version libre de l’éditeur de Microsoft, sans la marque ni la boutique d’extensions de Microsoft (elle utilise Open VSX). Arch uniquement, depuis le dépôt officiel ; Debian et Ubuntu n’ont pas de paquet. Incompatible avec Visual Studio Code (Microsoft) : installez l’un ou l’autre.

name: Zed
description: Éditeur de code rapide et collaboratif, écrit en Rust. Debian et Ubuntu : archive officielle installée dans /opt (pas de mise à jour automatique : réinstaller pour passer à la dernière version). Arch : dépôt officiel. Demande un bureau graphique et un processeur graphique compatible Vulkan.

command.install:
set -eu
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64|amd64) arch=x86_64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) arch=aarch64 ;;
  *) echo "Zed is not published for $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  apt-get update -qq
  apt-get install -y -qq ca-certificates curl
fi
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/zed-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
# Zed's official release archive (the one its own installer uses), read completely before anything is replaced.
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$tmp/zed.tar.gz" "https://cloud.zed.dev/releases/stable/latest/download?asset=zed&arch=$arch&os=linux&source=install.sh"
tar -tzf "$tmp/zed.tar.gz" >/dev/null
mkdir "$tmp/x"
tar -xzf "$tmp/zed.tar.gz" -C "$tmp/x" --no-same-owner
test -x "$tmp/x/zed.app/bin/zed"
chown -R root:root "$tmp/x/zed.app"
rm -rf /opt/zed.app
mv "$tmp/x/zed.app" /opt/zed.app
ln -sf /opt/zed.app/bin/zed /usr/local/bin/zed
install -D -m 644 /opt/zed.app/share/applications/dev.zed.Zed.desktop /usr/share/applications/dev.zed.Zed.desktop
install -D -m 644 /opt/zed.app/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/zed.png /usr/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/zed.png
if command -v update-desktop-database >/dev/null 2>&1; then update-desktop-database -q /usr/share/applications || true; fi
if command -v gtk-update-icon-cache >/dev/null 2>&1; then gtk-update-icon-cache -q -t /usr/share/icons/hicolor || true; fi
command.uninstall:
set -eu
if [ "$(readlink /usr/local/bin/zed 2>/dev/null)" = /opt/zed.app/bin/zed ]; then rm -f /usr/local/bin/zed; fi
rm -rf /opt/zed.app
rm -f /usr/share/applications/dev.zed.Zed.desktop /usr/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/zed.png
if command -v update-desktop-database >/dev/null 2>&1; then update-desktop-database -q /usr/share/applications || true; fi
